description: This source file defines the DeviceAdminSample class, a PreferenceActivity for managing device administration policies via the DevicePolicyManager API. It includes nested PreferenceFragments for control over device policies such as password requirements, encryption, lock/wipe functionalities, and device capabilities. Also includes a DeviceAdminReceiver implementation to handle admin-related callbacks.

classes.name: DeviceAdminSample
classes.description: Main activity class providing UI to explore and manage device policies via DevicePolicyManager, including nested PreferenceFragments for different policy controls, and an embedded DeviceAdminReceiver implementation.

classes.name: DeviceAdminSample.DeviceAdminSampleReceiver
classes.description: Receiver class that handles device admin callbacks such as enable/disable, password changes, and expiration notifications, showing user feedback via Toasts.

classes.name: DeviceAdminSample.DeviceAdminSampleReceiver2
classes.description: An empty placeholder subclass of DeviceAdminReceiver.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, acquiring references to DevicePolicyManager and the ComponentName for device admin.

methods.name: onBuildHeaders
methods.description: Provides top-level preference headers for the PreferenceActivity.

methods.name: isActiveAdmin
methods.description: Checks whether the app's DeviceAdminReceiver is currently active.

methods.name: isValidFragment
methods.description: Verifies if a fragment name is a valid fragment class for security.

methods.name: timeToDaysMinutesSeconds
methods.description: Converts milliseconds to a human-readable days/hours/minutes string.

methods.name: alertIfMonkey
methods.description: Detects if the user is a 'monkey' (automation test), shows warning, and prevents destructive actions.

methods.name: showToast
methods.description: Displays a Toast message with the provided text.

methods.name: DeviceAdminSampleReceiver.onReceive
methods.description: Handles generic broadcasts for the device admin, including aborting disable requests.

methods.name: DeviceAdminSampleReceiver.onEnabled
methods.description: Shows a toast when device admin becomes enabled.

methods.name: DeviceAdminSampleReceiver.onDisableRequested
methods.description: Provides a warning message when admin disable is requested, can abort the broadcast.

methods.name: DeviceAdminSampleReceiver.onDisabled
methods.description: Shows a toast when device admin is disabled.

methods.name: DeviceAdminSampleReceiver.onPasswordChanged
methods.description: Shows a toast when password is changed.

methods.name: DeviceAdminSampleReceiver.onPasswordFailed
methods.description: Shows a toast when a password attempt fails.

methods.name: DeviceAdminSampleReceiver.onPasswordSucceeded
methods.description: Shows a toast when a password attempt succeeds.

methods.name: DeviceAdminSampleReceiver.onPasswordExpiring
methods.description: Notifies the user when the password is about to expire, including expiration time.
